conviction_note: The reported quarter leans a little above the lower of two disputed revenue bars, because US retail volumes at Robinhood set records in Q3 while Futu guided only a modest sequential dip. Against that, every Q4 quarter-to-date series (HKEX October ADT, IBKR October equity, the 5 Nov Nasdaq rout) is weak, and that is what the call's QTD commentary will rest on. The stock is already -20% over 20 days and at its 52-week low, so the two roughly offset: p_up 52 on an 8% abs move, scaled +0.32, against a findings sum of +1.1. The bar is disputed, so the findings that depend on it are capped small.
bar: DISPUTED. Earnings Whispers/Benzinga Q3 2026 revenue consensus US$814.8M (about HK$6.34B, -11% QoQ, -1% YoY) per https://finviz.com/news/421246/futu-faces-its-first-real-test-of-post-regulation-momentum-as-revenue-is-expected-to-slip (2026-11-11). Chartmill/FXEmpire: HK$6.888B revenue (about US$885M, -4% QoQ) and EPS HK$23.09/ADS from 4 analysts, per https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/FUTU/estimates and https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/futu/earnings (snippets only, no page reachable). Futu gives no revenue guidance. Q2 2026 actual was HK$7,200.2M / US$918.2M (https://finviz.com/news/383934/futu-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results). My own estimate is about HK$6.8-7.1B, i.e. +8% against the lower bar and roughly in line with the higher one; print_vs_bar_pct +3 splits the two. Every finding that depends on the bar is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest about 3.3% of float, 5.7 days to cover (Equibles, about October 2026, https://equibles.com/stocks/futu/short-interest, per the sweep row; other sources put it at 5-9% on different bases). Not crowded. Baseline 25d skew +1.33 vol points (mild put bid), put/call OI 0.90, priced_direction_lean 'balanced'. The ATM legs were not two-sided, so there is no implied move. Tape: spot 84.125, -14.2% over 5 days, -19.9% over 20 days, -55% from the 52-week high, at the 52-week low. 20-day realised vol is 51.6% annualised.

findings.finding: US retail activity rose sequentially in Q3 2026. Robinhood's equity notional volume was a record US$992B against US$956B in Q2 (+4% QoQ), and its options contracts were a record 905M against 774M (+17% QoQ). US stocks were 78% of Futu's Q2 volume (HK$5.02T of HK$6.42T). On its Q2 call Futu said Q3 QTD volume was down 'modestly' from the Q2 record. The US$814.8M bar implies revenue -11% QoQ, a steeper fall than the US tape supports.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Volume-led beats have been bought. Q2 2026 beat on record HK$6.42T volume and the stock rose about 8.4% the next day (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/futu-nasdaqfutu-shares-up-84-following-earnings-beat-2026-08-21/). Q3 2025 'soared as Q3 earnings crush estimates on record trading volume' (https://ng.investing.com/news/earnings/futu-soars-as-q3-earnings-crush-estimates-on-record-trading-volume-93CH-2215383). A Q4 2025 revenue miss saw the stock plummet (https://thebambooworks.com/cn/%e5%bf%ab%e8%ae%af%ef%bc%9a%e5%9b%9b%e5%ad%a3%e5%ba%a6%e6%94%b6%e5%85%a5%e9%80%8a%e9%a2%84%e6%9c%9f-%e5%af%8c%e9%80%94%e8%82%a1%e4%bb%b7%e6%80%a5%e6%8c%ab/, size not retrieved).
findings.why_not_priced: The Earnings Whispers bar (-11% QoQ revenue) was set off Futu's August 'volume down modestly, accounts moderating' commentary and the HK slowdown, not off US retail prints that came out in late October. If the market had priced the US tape, the lower consensus would have moved up toward the HK$6.89B figure. The other source shows it up 15% in three months, so part of the street has.
findings.independence: Proxy, not a Futu number. Q2 comparison: https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3534009/robinhood-reports-second-quarter-2026-results (2026-07-29; Robinhood said July volumes were tracking near Q2 records). Futu's own mix: https://finviz.com/news/383934/futu-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results. The two consensus sources disagree on the bar, so the size is capped.

findings.finding: HKEX's headline cash ADT fell 11% YoY and 12% QoQ in Q3 2026, and HKEX revenue fell 7% QoQ. HK stocks were HK$1.17T (18%) of Futu's Q2 volume, so Futu's HK volume is likely down about 10% QoQ.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history of HK volume alone driving a Futu reaction. The US mix dominates since 2025.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. HKEX reported on 6 Nov and the lower bar already embeds a sequential decline. Filed because it is the one independent HK series and it points down.
findings.independence: HKEX monthly page: September ADT HK$201.9B (https://www.hkex.com.hk/Market-Data/Statistics/Consolidated-Reports/HKEX-Monthly-Market-Highlights, updated 2026-10-31). Shares a source with the Q4 finding below only through the October figure, which is used there and not here.

findings.finding: Every Q4 quarter-to-date series is weak, and the call's QTD commentary will rest on them. HKEX October 2026 ADT was HK$180.7B (-10.5% MoM from September's HK$201.9B, already the low of the year). IBKR October client equity fell 4% MoM to US$928.6B and DARTs were -4% YoY (+5% MoM). The Nasdaq fell 5.5% on 5 Nov (SOXX -12%), and HK tech sold off. Lower client asset marks and HK turnover point to soft October-November commentary on volume and client assets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Futu gives no numeric guide, so QTD commentary is the guide. A May 2026 price-target cut on softer near-term expectations cost -6.7% on the day (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Futu+slides+as+a+price-target+cut+and+softer+near-term+expectations+collide+with+profit-taking).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock is -14% in 5 days and -20% in 20 days, at its 52-week low, which looks like the market discounting exactly this. What may be left is the size of the QTD decline management states on the call; the street's Q4 numbers are not visible.
findings.independence: IBKR October metrics: https://fxnewsgroup.com/forex-news/retail-forex/interactive-brokers-registers-4-y-y-decrease-in-darts-in-october-2026/ (2026-11-02). Nasdaq rout: https://weissratings.com/en/instant-news-alerts/futu-holdings-limited-futu-up-5-8-time-to-open-a-position-at-last (2026-11-06). Three different sources.

findings.finding: Hong Kong equity capital markets set a Q3 record, about US$47.5B in IPOs, placements and blocks (the Zhongji Innolight IPO of about US$8B and Alibaba's US$10.2B follow-on). Q1-Q3 2026 had about 116 listings raising HK$387.9B. That supports Futu's IPO-subscription and margin-financing income in 'other income' (HK$715.8M in Q2, +61% YoY) and its interest income.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None isolated. Other income is about 10% of revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: Public macro fact, likely in the HK$6.89B estimate and possibly not in the US$814.8M one. Filed small as a proxy that Futu has not confirmed. Bloomberg-sourced coverage noted only 2 of the 10 largest deals since July traded above offer, which limits the retail enthusiasm read.
findings.independence: HKEX nine-month figures, 118 listings raising HK$388.4B (https://www.chinadailyhk.com/article/642355). Proxy.

findings.finding: Management on the Q2 call (August 2026) said cumulative regulatory outflows since the 22 May mainland rules were 'about mid-single-digit percentage of total client assets', that 'the bulk of the impact has already been absorbed in Q2', that HK client retention was above 98%, that net new funded accounts were moderating and that CAC rose again in July. This sets a lowered bar for client assets and account adds in Q3. The 800k full-year target was reaffirmed, per the EW preview.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the May crackdown the stock fell about 27-31% in a day. The Q2 print, where outflows 'barely dented' volume, was bought about +8.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is in the wire and therefore priced. Filed at 0 because it defines what the print is judged against: Q3 client assets and adds against a 'moderating' message. Whether net adds hold near 200k a quarter, which the 800k target needs, decides this line, and I found no tracker data on it.
findings.independence: Same commentary carried by https://finviz.com/news/421246/futu-faces-its-first-real-test-of-post-regulation-momentum-as-revenue-is-expected-to-slip (2026-11-11). One document read twice, counted once.

findings.finding: Interest income is supported. Interest income was HK$3.12B (43%) of Q2 revenue, with Futu's margin balance at HK$95.1B (+30.5% QoQ at end Q2). US rates were high through the quarter: the 10-year hit 5.34% on 1 Oct, the highest since 2002. Industry margin balances kept rising: IBKR margin loans were US$106.8B in October, +31% YoY and +2% MoM.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No isolated history. Interest income surprises usually come bundled with volume.
findings.why_not_priced: A proxy. A bar at -11% QoQ revenue implies interest income falling, which the rate path and the industry margin data do not show. Small because HK margin may have shrunk with HK turnover and the September/October risk-off.
findings.independence: 10-year yield context: https://weissratings.com/en/instant-news-alerts/futu-holdings-limited-futu-down-4-5-time-to-hit-the-eject-button (2026-10-02). Futu Q2 margin balance: https://finviz.com/news/383934/futu-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results.

findings.finding: Retail crypto activity fell sharply in Q3. Robinhood's crypto notional was US$50B (-38% YoY) and its crypto revenue fell 55%. This is a small drag on Futu's crypto trading line in Hong Kong and the US.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. Crypto is a small part of Futu's revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: Small and public. Filed as a proxy.
findings.independence: Same Robinhood release as finding 1 (https://finviz.com/news/409270/robinhood-reports-third-quarter-2026-results), on a different line.

findings.finding: The setup is washed out but not crowded. The stock is -14.2% over 5 days and -19.9% over 20 days, at the 52-week low and 55% below the high, on what looks like macro risk-off (Nasdaq rout, HK tech). Short interest is low at about 3.3% of float and 5.7 days to cover, so there is no squeeze fuel, but sentiment has been reset well below the Q2 print's level (about $95-104 in early November).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 came in after a drawdown and gapped up; the stock was about $95-100 before and rose about 8.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: By definition the drawdown is priced. Filed small because a lower starting point after a 20% run-down makes an in-line print more likely to be bought than sold. The skew (+1.33) is mild and does not say otherwise.
findings.independence: Baseline tape (sealed). The 6 Nov price of $103.62 (https://weissratings.com/en/instant-news-alerts/futu-holdings-limited-futu-up-5-8-time-to-open-a-position-at-last) shows the size of the fall since.

findings.finding: Of the US$800M buyback authorised on 18 Nov 2025 (running to end 2027), about US$418M was executed by 28 May 2026, leaving about US$382M (about 3% of a market cap near US$12B at $84). The program was itself announced with a Q3 print, so with the stock at its 52-week low a repurchase update, or a new return of capital, alongside the results is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 28 May cumulative-repurchase release came during the post-crackdown fall and did not stop it. The program announcement in Nov 2025 came with the Q3 2025 print.
findings.why_not_priced: Inference that a capital-return update comes with the print. The remaining capacity is public, but whether it was used in Q3-Q4 at these prices is not.
findings.independence: Earlier release, US$160M repurchased by 23 May: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/23/3300416/0/en/futu-repurchased-approximately-us-160-million-adss-in-share-repurchase.html. Same program.

outside_window.finding: The CSRC final decision on the RMB1.85B (about US$271M) proposed penalty is still pending; Futu can submit defences or request a hearing. No final decision was found as of mid-November. It is undated and not expected inside the window. It was largely provisioned in Q1 2026 (net income -61%).
UP Fintech (Tiger) reports Q3 2026 on 24 Nov 2026, after the exit window, so its peer read-across cannot inform this trade.

baseline_tension: The reported-quarter findings lean mildly positive. That cuts against a -20% 20-day run-down and a mild +1.33 put skew, but the Q4 QTD finding agrees with both, so net the set sits close to the balanced lean the options show.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar disputed: US$814.8M against HK$6.89B): the Robinhood/US-volume finding was capped from +1.5 to +1.0, the HK ECM finding from +0.5 to +0.4 and the interest-income finding from +0.5 to +0.4, because each depends on which bar holds.
Rule 3 / core: p_up moved from 53 to 52 because the bar is disputed; abs_move left at 8.
Rule 7: short interest checked (3.3% of float, 5.7 days, not crowded), so the negative QTD finding was left at -1.0; the skew is mild and nothing was resized for it.
Rule 1: the reaction history (Q2 beat bought about +8.4%, Q4 2025 miss sold) shows this name pays for the volume line, so no veto was applied.
